items.reasons: At 1x the hanging shirts merge into a muddy blue blob under the ring, so it doesn't read as a clothing rack. The garments are noisy overlapping blue shapes with no clear separation, and they spill wider than the rail ring and pedestal base.

The wooden shelf is a flat front elevation: the top and shelf planks are single-pixel rims with no lit top plane, and the microwave and rice cooker are shown straight-on from the front with no top surface.

The white slatted top on four legs reads as a desk or bench at 1x, not a drying rack. The small clothes hang from a lower rod as tiny bright sticker shapes (red and blue) that look like they float inside the frame instead of draping over the bars.

A grey bucket with a visible rim holds red, blue and white furled umbrellas; it reads at 1x, the scale is right next to the wall, and it sits on the floor. The white umbrella is low-contrast but acceptable.

The curtain is a flat front elevation: a vertical green pleated panel with only a thin top rail and no top plane or depth. It is a tall narrow strip that fills the canvas edge to edge, and in the room it looks like a door or wall panel rather than a free-standing screen on casters.
